operations.name: account.login
operations.description: Log in to a sync server with an existing account. Accounts are created in the app.

url.description: The server's address, with `https://` or `http://` optional.

operations.name: account.logout
operations.description: Forget the sync server and every project's sync state for it, as removing the server in Settings does.

operations.name: account.status
operations.description: The sync server and account this install uses, and optionally whether the server still accepts it.

check.description: Ask the server whether the stored token is still good; needs the network.

operations.name: backup.create
operations.description: Back up a project's saved files.

project.description: The project's name, or its server project id.

operations.name: backup.list
operations.description: A project's backups, oldest first.

project.description: The project's name, or its server project id.

operations.name: draft.apply
operations.description: Replace a scene's text with one of its drafts, saving the replaced text as a draft first.

previousDraftId.description: The draft holding the text it replaced; null when the text was unchanged.

operations.name: draft.create
operations.description: Save a scene's current text as a named draft.

operations.name: draft.delete
operations.description: Delete a draft for good.

operations.name: draft.list
operations.description: A scene's saved drafts, oldest first.

operations.name: draft.read
operations.description: A draft's markdown.

operations.name: entry.create
operations.description: Add an encyclopedia entry to a project.

aliases.description: Other names the entry goes by, matched in scenes like its name.

referencedBy.description: Scene ids whose references to this entry have been confirmed.

operations.name: entry.delete
operations.description: Delete an encyclopedia entry, and its image, for good.

aliases.description: Other names the entry goes by.

operations.name: entry.image.get
operations.description: An encyclopedia entry's image.

operations.name: entry.image.remove
operations.description: Remove an encyclopedia entry's image.

referencedBy.description: Scene ids whose references to this entry have been confirmed.

operations.name: entry.image.set
operations.description: Set an encyclopedia entry's image, replacing any it has. The extension is jpg, jpeg, png, or webp, and must match the image.

referencedBy.description: Scene ids whose references to this entry have been confirmed.

operations.name: entry.list
operations.description: A project's encyclopedia entries, with their aliases, optionally only one type or those with a tag.

aliases.description: Other names the entry goes by.

operations.name: entry.read
operations.description: An encyclopedia entry, with the scenes confirmed to reference it.

referencedBy.description: Scene ids whose references to this entry have been confirmed.

operations.name: entry.update
operations.description: Replace an encyclopedia entry's text, and its name, tags, or aliases when given.

referencedBy.description: Scene ids whose references to this entry have been confirmed.

operations.name: export.formats
operations.description: The formats project.export can produce.

operations.name: idea.archive
operations.description: Archive a story idea.

operations.name: idea.create
operations.description: Add a story idea.

operations.name: idea.delete
operations.description: Delete a story idea for good.

operations.name: idea.list
operations.description: Story ideas, which belong to the account rather than a project.

archived.description: True for only archived ideas, false for only active ones; omitted for both.

operations.name: idea.unarchive
operations.description: Return an archived story idea to the active ones.

operations.name: idea.update
operations.description: Replace a story idea's text, and its title or tags when given. An empty title clears it.

operations.name: note.create
operations.description: Add a note to a project.

operations.name: note.delete
operations.description: Delete a note for good.

operations.name: note.list
operations.description: A project's notes, optionally only those with a tag.

operations.name: note.read
operations.description: One note.

operations.name: note.update
operations.description: Replace a note's text, and its tags when given.

tags.description: Left out, the tags stay as they are.

operations.name: ops.list
operations.description: Every operation you may call, with JSON schemas for its input and output.

operations.name: project.create
operations.description: Create an empty project.

operations.name: project.delete
operations.description: Delete a project, and everything in it, for good. It must not be open in Hammer.

project.description: The project's name, or its server project id.

operations.name: project.export
operations.description: Export a project, or some of its scenes, in one of the formats from export.formats.

sceneIds.description: Limits the export to these scenes; omitted exports the whole story.

operations.name: project.import
operations.description: Create a project from a Markdown or RTF manuscript, split into scenes by its headings or a chapter pattern.

name.description: Left out, the title the file gives itself.

chapterPattern.description: A regular expression for the lines that start a chapter; left out, chapter, part, prologue, and epilogue.

chapterGroups.description: Put each chapter's scenes in a group.

operations.name: project.info
operations.description: A project's details: author, language, tags, word count goal, cached totals, and sync linkage.

project.description: The project's name, or its server project id.

operations.name: project.list
operations.description: List every project with its word count and when it was last edited.

wordCount.description: From the statistics cache; null until statistics are first calculated.

created.description: Null when the project's metadata can't be read.

operations.name: project.rename
operations.description: Rename a project. It must not be open in Hammer.

operations.name: scene.append
operations.description: Add markdown to the end of a scene's text, as a new paragraph.

operations.name: scene.archive
operations.description: Archive a scene: take it out of the story, keeping its text, drafts, and notes.

operations.name: scene.archived
operations.description: A project's archived scenes.

project.description: The project's name, or its server project id.

operations.name: scene.create
operations.description: Create an empty scene or group, at the end of its parent unless an index is given.

parentId.description: The group to create it in; left out, the top level.

index.description: Its position among its siblings; left out, the end.

operations.name: scene.delete
operations.description: Delete a scene, archived or not, or an empty group, for good.

operations.name: scene.meta.read
operations.description: A scene's outline, notes, tags, and references: the entries confirmed as in it, and those dismissed.

references.description: Entry ids confirmed as in the scene.

dismissedReferences.description: Entry ids the writer dismissed, which name matching no longer adds.

operations.name: scene.meta.write
operations.description: Change a scene's outline, notes, or tags. Fields left out keep their value.

references.description: Entry ids confirmed as in the scene.

dismissedReferences.description: Entry ids the writer dismissed, which name matching no longer adds.

operations.name: scene.move
operations.description: Move a scene or group to a position within a group, or the top level when parentId is left out. index is its position there after the move.

parentId.description: The group to move into; left out, the top level.

operations.name: scene.read
operations.description: A scene's markdown, including unsaved edits, with its outline, notes, and tags.

references.description: Entry ids confirmed as in the scene.

dismissedReferences.description: Entry ids the writer dismissed, which name matching no longer adds.

operations.name: scene.read.many
operations.description: Scenes in story order with their markdown, metadata, and the groups they sit in, a page of about maxWords, counting outlines and notes, at a time: every scene, a group's, or those in ids. Archived scenes are left out. Pass next as after for the following page; it is null on the last.

group.description: A group whose scenes, at any depth, to read.

path.description: Names of the groups containing the scene, outermost first.

references.description: Entry ids confirmed as in the scene.

dismissedReferences.description: Entry ids the writer dismissed, which name matching no longer adds.

next.description: The last scene's id when more follow, to pass as after; null on the last page.

operations.name: scene.references.set
operations.description: Change which entries a scene references. confirm marks entries as in the scene, and un-dismisses them; dismiss marks entries as only mentioned, so name matching stops adding them; clear forgets entries either way, so a later match can add them again.

references.description: Entry ids confirmed as in the scene.

dismissedReferences.description: Entry ids the writer dismissed, which name matching no longer adds.

operations.name: scene.rename
operations.description: Rename a scene or group.

operations.name: scene.tree
operations.description: A project's scenes and groups in story order, with word counts.

project.description: The project's name, or its server project id.

operations.name: scene.unarchive
operations.description: Return an archived scene to the story, at the end of the top level.

operations.name: scene.write
operations.description: Replace a scene's text with markdown. Mode draft saves it as a new draft of the scene and leaves the scene alone. Mode live replaces the scene's text, saving the old text as a draft first.

draftName.description: The new draft's name, in draft mode only.

draftId.description: The new draft, in draft mode.

previousDraftId.description: In live mode, the draft holding the text it replaced; null when the text was unchanged.

operations.name: search
operations.description: Search a project's scenes, notes, encyclopedia, and timeline. #tag in the query filters by tag.

operations.name: stats.activity
operations.description: Words written per day over a date range, plus lifetime words per device.

from.description: First day included, in the device's time zone; omitted for no lower bound.

to.description: Last day included; omitted for no upper bound.

devices.description: Lifetime totals, not limited to the range.

operations.name: stats.project
operations.description: A project's statistics, as its Home screen shows them.

recalculate.description: Recalculate even when the cached statistics are current.

chapters.description: Top-level scenes and groups, in story order.

topAppearances.description: People appearing in the most scenes.

operations.name: stats.sessions
operations.description: Writing sessions over a date range, from every device.

from.description: First day included, in the device's time zone; omitted for no lower bound.

to.description: Last day included; omitted for no upper bound.

operations.name: sync.run
operations.description: Sync the account and every linked project with the server, as Sync all does. A project with a conflict is left for the app.

project.description: Sync only this project; account changes and ideas still sync.

operations.name: sync.status
operations.description: Each project's link to the sync server, its last sync, and how many of its changes are waiting to sync.

linked.description: True once the project has synced.

operations.name: tag.find
operations.description: Every scene, note, entry, and timeline event carrying a tag.

operations.name: tag.list
operations.description: The tags used in a project, most used first, optionally counting one kind of entity.

operations.name: timeline.create
operations.description: Add an event to a project's timeline, at the end unless an index is given.

index.description: Its position in the timeline; left out, the end.

date.description: Free text; timelines are not bound to a calendar.

operations.name: timeline.delete
operations.description: Delete a timeline event for good.

date.description: Free text; timelines are not bound to a calendar.

operations.name: timeline.list
operations.description: A project's timeline events in order.

project.description: The project's name, or its server project id.

date.description: Free text; timelines are not bound to a calendar.

operations.name: timeline.move
operations.description: Move a timeline event to a position; index is its position after the move.

date.description: Free text; timelines are not bound to a calendar.

operations.name: timeline.read
operations.description: One timeline event.

date.description: Free text; timelines are not bound to a calendar.

operations.name: timeline.update
operations.description: Replace a timeline event's text, and its date or tags when given. An empty date clears it.

date.description: Free text; timelines are not bound to a calendar.
